articleTitle: A CLASS AB Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA) with a Slew Rate Enhancement (SRE) Auxiliary Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a CLASS AB Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA) incorporating an auxiliary circuit for slew rate enhancement (SRE). The presented OTA consists of four essential components: a reference current source, a SRE auxiliary circuit, a folded cascode input stage and a class AB output stage. Under the conditions of 30 V power supply voltage and 10 pF capacitive load, the operational transconductance am-plifier incorporate SRE significantly enhances the slew rate to 140 MV/s and 143 MV/s separately, resulting in a remarkable improvement by factors of 70 and 89.37 respectively compared to previous performance. Additionally, this advancement is achieved with only a slight increase in supply current, specifically by just 7.69%.

articleTitle: 3D-SIFT Point Cloud Registration Method Integrating Curvature Information
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Aiming at the issues that point cloud registration is limited by original pose low registration efficiency, and poor robustness, a 3D-SIFT point cloud registration method that integrates curvature information is proposed. First, the Gaussian curvature of the point cloud is calculated, and the scale space of the point cloud is weighted based on the Gaussian curvature. A Gaussian pyramid is constructed, and stable extreme points are detected through the difference of Gaussian (DoG). The main direction of the extreme points is determined to get feature points. Next, the feature points are described using the Fast Point Feature Histogram (FPFH) method improved with adaptive radius. The Random Sample Consensus (RANSAC) algorithm is used to preliminarily estimate the transformation matrix of the point cloud. Finally, the improved Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm is used for fine registration to obtain an accurate transformation matrix. Experiments on public point cloud datasets show that compared with the point cloud registration algorithm based on 3D-SIFT and the point cloud registration method based on the improved ISS algorithm, the proposed method has higher registration accuracy while maintaining algorithmic speed.

articleTitle: Research on 5G System Security in Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communication Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In the Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communication (URLLC) scenario defined by the International Telecommunication Union(ITU), 5G system needs to support both ultra-high reliability and low latency requirements. The system security in URLLC scenario needs to be designed based on the baseline security mechanism which has been defined in 3GPP technical specification TS 33.501. Firstly, the baseline security scheme of 5G system is given, then the redundant transmission mechanism is introduced to guarantee high-reliability transmission, the corresponding security impact and solution are considered, and then briefs the enhanced handover mechanism introduced by 5G to support low latency demand, focusing on the corresponding security mechanism. Finally, the possible future research directions of 5G URLLC security are given.

articleTitle: A Stochastic Resonance-Based Detection Method for Extremely Low Frequency Under Impulsive Noise
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: There are few published studies in the direction of extremely low frequency signal detection. Stochastic resonance has good performance in the field of weak signal detection under Gaussian noise conditions. In this paper, we design a stochastic resonance-based signal detection method to meet the receiver detection requirements for extremely low frequency signals in impulse noise. We utilize the normalized compression transformation function to preprocess the received signal for impulse suppression. The fitness between the parameters of the stochastic resonance system and the preprocessed data is explored to configure the stochastic resonance system parameters. The simulation results show that our method is slightly superior to the traditional method in comprehensive performance.

articleTitle: Image Authentication and Tamper Localization Based on Embedded Pixel-wise Check Code
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In the digital era, images serve as an important means of information transmission and communication. The authenticity and integrity of images are crucial for the credibility of information. Image authentication technology can verify the source and integrity of images, ensuring that the image content has not been tampered with or forged, thus enhancing the credibility of information. There are two types of authentication methods based on application scenarios, namely active and passive authentication. Passive authentication technology is based on the characteristics of specific images, so it cannot be extended to any image. In this paper, we propose a novel active image authentication technique based on pixel-wise check code. On the premise of maintaining image fidelity, which is the basic requirement of data hiding technology, the pixel check code is hidden in the pixel itself. The method enables the image receiver to accurately detect and locate any size tampering on the image. Through a large number of experiments, we verified the feasibility of the technical solution and the expected performance.

articleTitle: A Logical Architecture of Space Sky Integrated Network Based on SDN Controller and Low Earth Satellite Constellation Network Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The integrated network logic architecture of space and space based on SDN controller and low orbit satellite constellation network control technology integrates software defined network (SDN) and low orbit satellite constellation network to achieve seamless communication and unified management on a global scale. This architecture leverages the centralized management and programming capabilities of SDN controllers, while also utilizing the global coverage and high bandwidth transmission characteristics of low orbit satellite constellation networks, to achieve close connectivity and collaborative work between space, air, and ground networks. Under this architecture, the SDN controller becomes the main node of various network devices, and achieves efficient management and optimization of the entire air space integrated network by guiding and coordinating network traffic routing, resource allocation, security policies, and other functions.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective Optimization Study for Directional Chargers in WSN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: To address the charging efficiency of mobile chargers in WSN, it is assumed in existing studies that the charging range of the charger is circular. However, in practice the charging range of the charger is sectorized, which is the directional charger. In this paper, a multi-objective optimization model is developed for the application scenario of directional charger with the objectives of minimum charging time and maximum coverage, a Particle Swarm Optimization based Multi-objective Optimization algorithm is designed. Simulation experimental data show that the multi-objective optimization algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively improve the charging efficiency of the directional charger, and the algorithm is more suitable for nonlinear charging model.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Downlink SWIPT-Based Cooperative NOMA in THz Band
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The integration of non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) technology and terahertz (THz) technology shows great promise. However, considering the significant path loss of THz links, there may be scenarios where the base station is unable to establish links with remote users in NOMA systems. To address this issue, we consider a two-user NOMA system where the near user acts as a half-duplex relay, cooperating in the communication between the base station and the far user. In this setup, we utilize simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) technology to power the near user. To account for various practical factors, we take into consideration path loss, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha-\mu$</tex> fading, pointing error, and transceiver hardware impairments (HIs). We derive the outage probability (OP) for NOMA users and system throughput. Additionally, we obtain the diversity gain of OP under high signal-to-noise ratio. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the presented performance analysis and reveal that the impact of HIs on OP performance is significant.

IEEE Keywords: Simultaneous wireless information and power transfer

articleTitle: Clutter Suppression and Weak Target Detection Using EEMD-WOA Algorithm for FMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Weak target detection poses a significant challenge in FMCW radar systems due to substantial near-range clutter. Conventional MTI algorithms and clutter map methods rely on the intensity and doppler frequency differences between the clutter and the moving target in multiple data frames. However, the suppression performance becomes inadequate when the clutter intensity is substantial and the multipath effect is significant. Additionally, feeble target leakage occurs and target detection is impaired following clutter suppression. This paper presents a joint EEMD-WOA processing framework that addresses the abovementioned issues. The framework eliminates clutter by employing ensemble empirical modal decomposition (EEMD) of multi-frame signals to extract the signal subspace. Additionally, the whale optimization algorithm (WOA) is utilized to extract signals by exploiting the disparity in higher-order statistics between the clutter and the targets, thereby accomplishing the objective of weak target detection. Simulation analysis substantiates the superior detection performance of this method in comparison to alternative methods.

articleTitle: Fusion of Prior Knowledge and Gated Neural Networks for Short Text Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative approach to short text recognition, namely the Fusion of Text Word Frequency Features with Gated Neural Networks. Due to the limited and low inter-correlation of information in short texts, traditional classification methods perform poorly in handling such texts. To address this issue, we propose a novel model called the PK-BIGRU (Priori Knowledge BIGRU) model. This model leverages TF-IDF calculations of text vocabulary word frequencies to generate text feature vectors with prior knowledge, which are then fused with the context semantic feature vectors extracted by BIGRU from the original text. This innovative approach extends the feature information of short texts, significantly improving the recognition efficiency of the model. In real short text validation and comparative experiments, the PK-BIGRU model demonstrates outstanding performance, achieving the highest precision improvement of 1.9%, the highest recall improvement of 3.3%, and the highest F1 score improvement of 2.4%. These metrics surpass other models in various aspects. The PK-BIGRU model achieves a balance between semantic understanding and frequency-based information capture, exhibiting a clear advantage in handling short text scenarios where traditional methods struggle, by leveraging the characteristics of both types of information.

articleTitle: Adaptive Optimization Scheme for RIS-Aided mmWave-NOMA Systems with Hybrid Beamforming
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: An adaptive scheme is proposed for resource allocation in two-user millimeter-wave (mmWave) non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) systems with the assistance of reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) that is employed to aid downlink data transmission. Through the mathematical transformation, the energy efficiency (EE) in the communication systems are derived for performance evaluation and optimization. Then, an optimization problem for EE maximization is formulated. To deal with it, an adaptive algorithm is presented, which is based on alternating optimization (AO), penalty function method, majorization minimization (MM), and Riemannian manifold optimization (RMO).

articleTitle: Research on Tunnel Crack Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Aiming at the misjudgment, omission, and insufficient feature extraction ability of the existing deep learning for tunnel crack detection, an improved algorithm model based on YOLOv5 network is proposed. Firstly, the CBAM attention mechanism is introduced to focus on the image successively in channel dimension and spatial dimension, so as to highlight the crack features, and then the BotNet network structure is added into the backbone network of YOLOv5, and the location information between the crack features is interconnected by utilizing the combination of the convolutional neural network and the global self-attention mechanism in the BotNet network. The results show that the improved algorithm proposed in this paper can better extract the crack region information compared with the YOLOv5 model, can recognize cracks of different sizes, and has higher detection accuracy.

articleTitle: SDN Controller Deployment Strategy based on Electric Power Communication Network Community Partitioning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The current electric power communication services encompass a wide variety of services with significant differences in their business requirements. Traditional electric power communication networks struggle to meet the diverse needs of these services. Software-Defined Networking (SDN) has introduced a more convenient and efficient approach to network management and upgrades for electric power communication networks. However, the traffic in electric power communication networks is characterized by spatiotemporal dynamics, leading to an uneven distribution of SDN controllers, which severely impacts network performance. To address the controller deployment issue in SDN networks, this paper establishes a quantification model for SDN network controller power, divides the SDN network into communities based on community modularity, and proposes a controller deployment strategy tailored to electric power communication network community division, optimizing the power for each controller within each community effectively. This resolves the controller deployment issue in SDN networks. Finally, a controller deployment algorithm based on power optimization is implemented through simulation experiments, and the experiments demonstrate that the algorithm proposed in this paper, in comparison with the baseline algorithm, exhibits lower total controller power consumption and average response time. Furthermore, it reduces controller power fluctuation and latency jitter, thereby enhancing the quality of network service.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Technical Issues Faced in the Calibration of Multi-camera Vision Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Calibrating a multi-camera vision detection system is a critical step in ensuring system accuracy and stability. However, there are several technical challenges in the calibration process. This article discusses some of the technical issues faced in calibrating multi-camera vision detection systems. Firstly, the issue of camera synchronization can affect image consistency and temporal alignment, requiring the identification of appropriate synchronization schemes. Secondly, lens distortion in cameras can affect geometric accuracy, necessitating distortion correction. Field of view coverage issues can affect the system's ability to capture the entire target area, thereby requiring considerations of camera layout and field of view angles. Furthermore, the selection and layout of calibration targets are crucial. Calibration targets need to cover the camera's field of view and provide sufficient feature points for calibration. Therefore, proper hardware design and suitable calibration methods can effectively address the technical challenges in calibrating multi-camera vision detection systems, improving system performance and reliability.

articleTitle: Fully Distributed Event-Triggered Consensus of Linear Multi-Agents Systems With Input Delay and Unknown Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: This paper focuses on the fully distributed event-triggered linear multi-agents issue with network delay and external disturbance. Based on the designed observer, slide mode control theory is introduced to deal with the unknown disturbance. Compared with the previous related works, the deterministic sinusoidal disturbance is no longer needed, and a known network delay is introduced for practical reasons. Without requirement of global information and Zeno behavior, the event-triggered consensus protocol is exported, which is fully distributed. By utilizing a 4 nodes multi-agents system simulation, we attested the validity of our control laws.

articleTitle: Research on Algorithm for License Plate Detection in Complex Scenarios Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: With the advancement of transportation technology, the management of vehicles on the roadside has become a pressing issue for traffic management and parking authorities. Consequently, non-fixed-scene license plate detection has become a focal point for academic and industrial research and solutions. In response to the inadequacies of existing license plate detection algorithms in complex environments, such as different locations and angles, the papper employed the PaddleOcrV4 as license plate detection model based on deep learning. This model utilized PaddlePaddle as its foundational framework and replaces MobileNetv3 with PP-LCNetV3 in the license plate detection network to reduce interference from complex environmental backgrounds. In the license plate recognition network, PP-HGNet served as the backbone network, effectively improving detection accuracy. This paper primarily designed a solution for license plate detection and text recognition based on OCR technology. Experimental results indicated that the algorithm presented in this paper outperforms PaddleOcrV3 and PaddleOcrV3 in terms of detection accuracy, achieving a precision rate of 96% on the test dataset.

articleTitle: Research on RAN Slicing Resource Allocation Techniques for Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Considering the requirements of on-demand customization, scalability, and security isolation in power application scenarios, it is a challenging issue to achieve flexible resource allocation and optimal isolation effects on limited wireless resources while meeting the basic network needs and maximizing the utilization of wireless access network slicing resources. This article proposes a method that targets multiple service access requirements in the power industry. It performs dual-layer isolation configuration and adjustment of radio access network (RAN) slicing resources across different time scales, including resource isolation configuration solutions for service demand points at a large time grain size and UE resource adaptive adjustment solutions at a small time grain size. This method supports the allocation of channels to multiple types of UEs with different requirements in complex environments, thereby maximizing spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on International UI Graphic Design Color Intelligent Matching System Based on Internet Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: An automatic color matching system for industrial production is introduced. The architecture can be divided into three layers: data access layer, business logic layer and display layer. The system uses spectral color meter, central processing unit, storage device and virtual physical sensing game device. Use the feature color in the image as the weight for each node. The connection between two nodes is based on the number of occurrences on the same image. This paper proposes a color design support method based on color network. Through the analysis of different color combinations, the paper puts forward the color selection method which can embody the connotation of traditional culture to the greatest extent. This paper is an innovative UI graphic design color intelligent matching system that uses a computer algorithm to extract the main tone and auxiliary tone of the network model, and is verified. The experimental results show that the system has a certain deviation from the expected color matching, but this deviation is small, so the resulting color difference will not cause any impact on the user's visual performance.

articleTitle: Self-organization Algorithm of Formation Network based on Hybrid MAC Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Under battlefield conditions, time slot networks need to bind node identities in advance, and there is a problem of the entire network being paralyzed due to the destruction of the main node. In response to the demand for self-organizing construction of formation networks, the paper proposes a self-organizing algorithm for formation networks based on hybrid media access control protocol. This algorithm competes for the master node through random competition, achieving self-organized binding node identity in the network, and improving the security of formation networking; In response to the problem of low channel utilization caused by data conflicts in random competition protocols, an interactive reservation protocol is used to allocate transmission time slots for each application node, achieving real-time data transmission without conflicts among all network nodes. Finally, the algorithm was validated through simulation. The results showed that 20 nodes completed networking within 6s. and analyze the impact of time synchronization. The algorithm can effectively support the demand for self-organizing the formation network information platform with real-time data exchange and anti-destruction ability in typical scenarios such as future collaborative operations and collaborative detection.

articleTitle: Machine Unsupervised Abnormal Sound Detection Based on Residual Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: To solve the low frequency, wide variety and changing problems in machine abnormal sound detection, we propose an unsupervised machine abnormal sound detection method based on residual autoencoder technology. This method can automatically learn and capture the characteristics of abnormal sounds without the need to mark a large number of abnormal samples in advance. First, Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients(MFCC) is used to construct the acoustic features of the normal sound, then residual autoencoder is used to reconstruct the acoustic features, and finally the anomaly fraction between the acoustic features reconstructed by the audio features to be measured and the acoustic features reconstructed by the normal sound is calculated. This method performs well in correctly identifying the abnormal sound.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Anti-Jamming Technology of Frequency-Swept Continuous Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Frequency sweep continuous wave radar has a broad application prospect in the field of portable short-range battlefield reconnaissance radar. However, in engineering design and combat application, radar faces some problems such as emission leakage and strong ground clutter interference. Therefore, a comprehensive anti-jamming technology is proposed, which integrates waveform design technology, antenna anti-jamming technology, transceiver anti-jamming technology and signal processing anti-jamming technology. The anti-jamming performance of the comprehensive anti-jamming technology is verified by actual equipment.

articleTitle: Design of a Rapid Evaluation System Based on Telemetry Data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In response to the problem of long preparation time and inability to meet the real-time evaluation requirements of test aircraft after flight when existing evaluation systems use airborne data for data analysis, a rapid evaluation system is designed using telemetry data as a data source to achieve real-time analysis, processing, analysis, and storage of key parameters. After flight, data can be quickly provided to support the evaluation task, Meet the rapid evaluation needs of the testing machine.

articleTitle: Stereo Matching Algorithm Based on Improved Census Transform and Fusion Cost
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: To solve the problem that traditional Census transform relies too much on window center information is easily disturbed by noise, and has poor matching effect in weak texture and occlusion area, a stereo matching algorithm based on improved Census transform and fusion cost is proposed. In the cost calculation stage, the improved Census transform is integrated with the sum of absolute difference and gradient feature to calculate the initial cost. In the cost aggregation stage, a guided filter is introduced to constrain the regular coefficients with edge perception weights. The winner-takes-all algorithm is used to calculate the parallax value, and the parallax is optimized by left-right consistency detection, uniqueness constraint and median filtering to get the final parallax map. The proposed algorithm is tested by using Middlebury platform standard images. The experimental results show that the average mismatching rate is 4.91%, and the matching accuracy is improved compared with the traditional Census algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-Path-Based Cascaded Channel Estimation for Reconfigurable Intelligent Surface Assisted Multi User MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Cascading channel estimation is the main challenge in implementing reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) assisted multi-input multi-out (MIMO) communication systems. With the increase of paths between the RIS and the base station (BS) (RIS- BS), more environmental interference factors are introduced, which makes the existing algorithms have defects in the stability of estimation performance. This paper presents a method named Multi-Path-Based Cascaded Channel Estimation Procedure (MP-CCE). Based on the Two-Step (Subspace) Multi User Joint Channel Estimation Procedure (S-MJCE) algorithm, the practicality of the algorithm is enhanced by reasonably adding environmental factors between RIS-BS. The simulation results show that the complexity of the MP-CCE algorithm and the S-MJCE algorithm is on the same order of magnitude, where the former has slightly increased complexity, but its estimation performance stability is significantly better than the S-MJCE algorithm and the simultaneous orthogonal matching pursuit (SOMP) algorithm.

articleTitle: A Secure Data Collection Scheme in Clustered Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) is a vital part of Internet of Things which has been applied in many fields to monitor and collect data from the environment. When the sensor nodes collect data from the monitored area and transmit it to the sink, unequal power consumption and data security must be considered. We propose a secure data collection algorithm for the energy limitation and vulnerable data security of wireless sensor networks. First, we applied an Improved Nondominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm (NSGA) for clustering, improving clustering efficiency by dynamically adjusting the crossover probability and the mutation probability. Hybrid Compressed Sensing (CS) strategy is used to reduce the data overhead. Meanwhile, we employed secret sharing algorithm to protect the measurement matrix for compressed data collection. The simulation results showed that the proposed algorithm has good performance in term of protecting data privacy, and network lifetime is prolonged by 29.7% ~54.5%.

articleTitle: A SEU-hardened Design of Satellite Antenna Control Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that space products are susceptible to SEU resulting in program disorder, a SEU-hardened design of satellite antenna control circuit is proposed based on software refactoring of DSP and periodic refresh of SRAM FPGA in orbit. Intelligent refresh chip BSV2 working principle is introduced and applied circuit is designed, while DSP software refactoring strategy and implement method are introduced. Experimental results show that the design above can repair system dysfunction effectively caused by SEU and improve reliability of space products in long-life cycle. There is practical significance in engineering.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aircraft Swarm Detection Method Based on RF Features and Unsupervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Aiming at the current problem that UAV swarms are susceptible to environmental interference during detection and classification based on image recognition, and that traditional signal recognition makes it difficult to accurately extract features and has poor real-time performance, a UAV swarm detection method based on RF features and unsupervised learning is proposed. Firstly, the detected UAV RF signal is processed by a combination of the wavelet transform, independent component analysis (ICA) on linear dimensionality reduction algorithm, and unified manifold approximation and projection (UMAP) of nonlinear dimensionality reduction algorithm to obtain the RF signal spectrum; then, based on X-means algorithm (X-means), the number of clusters is estimated and the detection and identification of UAV swarms are carried out; finally, the proposed method can effectively detect and identify UAV swarms, as shown by simulation verification. The method can effectively detect and recognize UAV swarms with a recognition accuracy of up to 95%, and the recognition accuracy reaches 90% when the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is greater than 20 dB. Compared with traditional methods such as convolutional neural network (CNN) and support vector machine (SVM), the recognition accuracy and robustness of the proposed method are improved by 5% and 30%, which provides a certain reference value for the detection and recognition of UAV clusters in flight test.

articleTitle: Research on Image Steganography for the Instant Messaging and Broadcasting in a Collaborative Unmanned Cluster
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: For the unmanned platform collaborative operation, the communication between each platform or the broadcasting in the cluster is easy to be eavesdropped and stolen, which leads to the secret leakage and even threatens the security of the operation platform. The communication in the cluster requires to remain real-time as the steganography apply well. In this paper, an image steganography-based encryption scheme for navigation and detection information is newly designed for unmanned platform clusters. Several common image steganography algorithms such as J-UNIWARD, HUGO, WOW and LSB, are used to analyze the impact of image steganography on the performance of collaborative navigation and visual odometer positioning. After simulation and experimental verification, the feasibility of image steganography in collaborative navigation and detection in clusters is proved, and it is also pointed out that the time-delay difference between steganography and decryption will bring large errors to collaborative localization.

articleTitle: Research on High-Speed Clock Synchronization Technology for Inter-satellite Coherent Laser Communication Link
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In order to solve the interstellar high-rate transmission problem in satellite Internet and guarantee the rapid construction of space-based broadband information network, this paper focuses on the research of high-speed clock synchronization technology for interstellar coherent laser communication. We achieved clock synchronization of 100 Gbps high-speed signals by optimizing the Gardner feedback all-digital clock synchronization algorithm, which based on the PM-QPSK heterodyne digital coherent system. The traditional clock synchronization algorithm is difficult to meet the high precision synchronization demand of 100G rate laser communication. The clock synchronization algorithm described in this paper has the characteristics of high speed, full digital and full feedback. In addition, a high-speed clock synchronization technology verification test was built in the indoor equivalent verification environment of the inter-satellite laser communication terminal. The 100 Gbps high-speed coherent laser communication is realized, and the bit error rate is better than 1E-7. The effectiveness of the high-speed clock synchronization algorithm is verified, which is of great significance to the development of high-speed coherent laser communication between satellites.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Measuring FM Signal Frequency Modulation Index by Bessel Function Ratio Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In this paper, by combining the first kind of Bessel function with the principle and characteristics of FM signal, the spectral image characteristics of FM signal can be observed, the mathematical relationship between carrier frequency components and different side frequency components and the first kind of Bessel function is obtained, and the ratio method of Bessel function is improved. In order to verify the accuracy and measurement accuracy of the method, The simulation experiment is carried out based on MATLAB simulation software and the test is carried out by STM32H750 series single chip microcomputer. Bessel function ratio method is simple and clear, the measurement error of FM index is less than 0.1, the precision is high, the running speed is fast, and the hardware limitation is reduced.

articleTitle: Research on High-Precision Composite Axis PAT System for Inter-Satellite Dynamic Laser Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In response to the requirements for stable tracking in inter-satellite dynamic laser communication links, and in order to ensure the rapid construction of space-based broadband information networks, we conducted research on a high-precision composite axis targeting, acquisition and tracking system for inter-satellite dynamic laser communication. Based on the composite axis targeting acquisition and tracking (PAT) system composed of large range coarse tracking unit and large bandwidth fine tracking unit, the composite axis servo control model is established and optimized. Compared with the traditional 2D servo control model, this model has the characteristics of large range, large bandwidth, no independent beacon and high precision, which can effectively support the accurate chain construction of laser communication. Meanwhile, through the verification test of the inter-satellite laser communication terminal set up in the indoor equivalent verification environment, in the external high-frequency disturbed environment of 1Hz@100 μrad, 100Hz@4 μrad, 200Hz@0.6μrad, the chain is built within 10s, and the tracking accuracy RMS value is 2.54μrad (3σ). This experiment verifies the effectiveness of the high-precision Pointing, Acquisition, and Tracking (PAT) system, holding significant importance for the development of high-speed coherent inter-satellite laser communication.

articleTitle: Research on Hidden Watermark Traceability Technology Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: This article summarizes the development of traditional data hiding technology and proposes a new solution. This scheme converts ordinary data into invisible encoding, embeds it into paper materials, and uses convolutional neural networks for model training and recognition. This method can better protect the privacy and security of data, improve the accuracy and reliability of reading hidden information, and is convenient and easy to use. This scheme provides a new approach and direction for the development and application of data hiding technology.

articleTitle: A xDeepFM Recommendation Model Integrating User Behavior Sequences and Semantic Features
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Existing recommendation models are primarily constructed based on traditional methodologies and neural network approaches. However, these models lack depth in capturing the diverse interests of users and the rich semantic content. Moreover, there's a gap in researching the shift in user interests. To enhance the mining capability of recommendation models in these aspects, this paper introduces attention mechanisms to express the diversity of user interests. Concurrently, textual features are integrated. After capturing the sequential information of user behavior, a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network is employed for learning and processing. By deeply integrating the attention mechanism, recurrent neural networks, and the xDeepFM model, a recommendation model of xDeepFM that combines user behavior sequences and semantic features is proposed. Comparative experiments are conducted using public datasets, and the model is evaluated with commonly used metrics for classification tasks. Experimental results indicate that, compared to the xDeepFM model, the AUC improved by an average of 7%, and the F1-Score increased by an average of 6%. This demonstrates that the proposed algorithm possesses superior recommendation performance, verifying its efficacy and feasibility.

articleTitle: Research on Building Extraction Method in Remote Sensing Images Based on Two-Channel Cascade Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Deep learning has significant advantages in extracting buildings from remote sensing images. Aiming at the demand of extracting remote sensing buildings from complex scenes, we propose a novel approach based on Two-Channel Cascade strategy. The preprocessed remote sensing image is input into different edge detection algorithms, and the Structural Similarity index is extracted, use four algorithms with best values of index performs weighted averages on detect results to obtain finer edge images. The proposed Two-Channel Cascade Network skillfully fuses the performance of different baselines. TCCnet cascaded image features through a two-channel strategy to obtain rich features of RGB images, and optimized training through depth supervision. At the same time, the residual mapping of edge image is introduced to enhance the attention to local features and edge clarity. We use multiple losses to achieve pixel categories imbalance segmentation and highlight the boundary by fusing BCE loss, SSIM loss and IoU loss. Compared the TCCnet with Unet, Segnet, and FCN8s. The results show that TCCnet outperforms other models in terms of qualitative and quantitative and ablation experiments were carried out for each innovative module, Which proves the building extract effect of the TCCnet is more refined.

articleTitle: Exploring Spatial Optical to Optical Fiber Coupling Techniques for Optical Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Spatial optical-fiber coupling of optical array antennas is a crucial technology for ensuring communication distances in spatial optical communication networks. A novel spatial optical-fiber coupling method is proposed to overcome the limitations of traditional spatial optical-fiber coupling, which include difficulties in decoupling, poor consistency, and low repeatability. We first present the optical and structural design of the coupling alignment system, and then describe how to make adjustments to the optical array antennas' positions by the utilization of optical feedback using cameras. After that, the analysis of the impact of relative aperture, lateral error and axis error on coupling efficiency is presented. The results show that the corresponding optimal relative aperture is 0.22 for space light at wavelength. With a lateral error of 10, the coupling efficiency is close to 0, and when the axial error exceeds 100, the coupling efficiency is below 0.1. Finally, coupling experiments show that the average coupling efficiency of the proposed method is 77.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, which meets the requirements of the antenna.

articleTitle: A High-Performance Low-Latency Extended TPC Decoding Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: TPC codes have been of great interest as a high-performance, low-complexity error-correcting code. For decoding, a soft-input soft-output (SISO) iterative decoding algorithm is used, which is the same as the decoding method of Turbo codes. The BER performance of Turbo product codes is similar to that of Turbo codes, but the decoding complexity is lower than that of Turbo codes. Therefore, Turbo product code has become a popular code word studied by experts in the field of channel coding in recent years, and it has a wide application prospect in the communication system which has high requirements on transmission rate. The extended TPC code used in this paper can reduce the decoding delay by about 35%, increase the throughput by 35%, and improve the decoding performance by about 0.3dB, based on the chase-2 algorithm, with almost no increase in the amount of arithmetic and hardware complexity, and only a change in the way of selecting the judgment code word.

articleTitle: Successive Location Information Assisted User Selection for Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Massive multi-input multi-output (Massive MIMO) technology is considered as one of the most breakthrough technologies in the fifth generation wireless communication networks. However, with the rapid growth of the number of users and antennas, traditional signal processing techniques will produce computational complexity that the system cannot burden. At the same time, the number of users is increasing, and increased interference between users can lead to serious system performance losses. In response to many challenges, a two-stage scheme Successive Location Information Assisted User Selection (SLI-AUS) scheme is proposed in this paper. Specifically, we first propose constrained spatial density clustering (DBCluC) for all candidate users using successive location information. According to the clustering results, the user class with the worst channel energy was screened out. In the second stage, based on the location information, the geometric Angle which can represent the correlation between channels is calculated, and the progressive SINR which represents the channel energy is adopted as the criteria for user selection. The simulation results show that compared with the original scheme, the proposed scheme has lower computational complexity while ensuring the system performance.

articleTitle: Image Super-Resolution Reconstruction by Blur Kernel Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The paper combines blur kernel estimation and dictionary learning and proposes an image super-resolution reconstruction algorithm based on Blur Kernel Estimation (Dictionary Learning based on Blur Kernel Estimation, DL-BKE). The proposed algorithm performs blur kernel estimation on the test image before reconstruction of the test image and replaces the blurring process in image preprocessing with the obtained blur kernel, and then reconstructs the high-resolution image using the dictionary learning method. The experimental results show that the DL-BKE algorithm robustly reconstructs better high-resolution images for test images with different blurring degradation processes compared to the classical super-resolution algorithm.

articleTitle: Software Defect Prediction via Code Language Models
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: Software defect prediction has been effective practice to improve software quality and avoid attacks. Traditional defect prediction models with static or other features cannot understand syntactic and semantic structures well. Recently, large language models like GPT-series show impressive energy on considerable number of tasks. In the realm of software engineering, it has been shown that code language models largely benefit a broad set of code-related downstream tasks. In this paper, we employ code language models with distinct architectures for defect prediction. we propose a unified bi-modal input representation to enhance the comprehension of semantic information. Furthermore, a new bi-modal dataset is proposed based on the PROMISE repository and the engineering files. A large number of experiments are conducted on both within and cross project for evaluation and comparison. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method for software defect prediction, which outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines. Among the three architectures, encoder-only achieve the most effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Simulation Technology of Satellite-Ground Wireless Channel Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: With the increasing demand for satellite communications and the development of new technologies, in recent years, more and more countries and institutions have joined in the development and use of Ka-band satellite communications systems. Aiming at the requirement of seamless switching communication between multi-orbit, multi-satellite, and satellite-ground coverage areas, this paper designs a satellite-ground wireless channel digital simulation system based on the digital twin. The digital simulation system realizes the visual demonstration and verification of seamless switching communication between multi-orbit, multi-satellite, and satellite-ground coverage areas in the satellite-ground communication scenario. It is used for system simulation performance verification of Ka-band satellite communication load and terminal, shortens its development cycle.

articleTitle: DUCG-based Spacecraft Fault Diagnosis Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of intelligent fault diagnosis of spacecraft, this paper builds a diagnostic model based on Dynamic Uncertain Causality Graph (DUCG). This model solves the issues with data-driven and model-based methods, such as poor interpretability, high data dependence, and low diagnostic correctness. The DUCG methodology relies on the expertise of the domain experts to demonstrate uncertainties between the spacecraft telemetry parameters and possible faults in a graphic way. Notably, DUCG exhibits high diagnostic accuracy and interpretability, even in the absence of existing fault data. The diagnostic model developed utilizing the DUCG contains a total of 29 faults and 110 telemetry parameters. Empirical findings indicate that the model achieves a remarkable accuracy rate of 100%. The research results in this paper are of great significance for the development and promotion of spacecraft fault diagnosis technology.

articleTitle: A Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning Scheme Using Threshold Multi-Key Homomorphic Encryption
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: As an emerging technology of artificial intelligence, Federated learning (FL) enables distributed data users to collectively train a global model while ensuring that the data remains local. FL has brought a new method to data-sensitive applications that require data fusion to a large extent. However, The problem of data leakage and privacy threats still exists. Multi-key homomorphic encryption (MKHE) can effectively facilitate the secure utilization of confidential data from multiple participants. In MKHE, the property of threshold allows for partial users to drop out during decryption, called failure-robust. Previous privacy-preserving federated learning (PPFL) based on MKHE schemes have seldom considered the failure-robust problem. To address this issue, we propose a threshold MK-CKKS (tMK-CKKS) scheme to design a PPFL scheme. In our scheme, a public key is generated by a joint secret key. The joint secret key is divided into secret shares using {0,1}-LSSS, and these secret shares serve as individual secret keys for each user. The model updates are encrypted with the public key before being uploaded to the cloud server for aggregation. For decryption, a subset of participants involved in the process only needs to satisfy the access structure to complete it. Our scheme can prevent privacy leakage from shared information of users and achieves threshold decryption while ensuring robustness against honest-but-curious users and collusion attacks between users and the cloud server.

articleTitle: Cross-Space-Time 3D Human Body Pose Estimation based on Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Communication Technology and Information Technology (ICCTIT)
abstract: The precise estimation of 3D human pose from monocular videos poses a formidable challenge, primarily attributed to the complexities introduced by depth blur and self-occlusion. We observed significant differences in the movement of the same joint at different times. However, previous methods were unable to effectively simulate the corresponding relationships of the same joint at different times. For this purpose, we advocate for the adoption of a Transformer-centric design, which we've dubbed the Cross Connection Transformer (CCT). It can learn the dependency relationships between joints at different times and stages, and then capture information from multiple stages for cross attention and feature fusion. This task can be decomposed into two stages: first, employ a spatio-temporal encoder, to capture the temporal motion patterns of individual joints and learn the spatial correlation between joints. In the subsequent phase, the process entails acquiring proficiency in cross-spatial communication and amalgamating diverse spatial features to formulate the ultimate 3D pose. Through two innovative interaction modules, this model explicitly encodes local and global dependencies between body joints, providing a rich representation of body joints. This is crucial for capturing small changes across frames, namely the representation between features. Following rigorous experimental validation, our CCT model showcased good performance on the demanding datasets Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP. The outcomes underscore our model's superiority, surpassing the advanced pure Transformer method MixSTE. Notably, our model achieves a performance improvement of 2% beyond the optimal results on Human3.6M.
